issues.description: ArrayHelpers helper method is named differently between artifacts: the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java) declares a method named 'appendElement(T[] array, T element)', while the template's Stock class calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The provided solution and its ArrayHelpers use the name 'addElementToArray'. This naming mismatch causes a compilation error in the template (unresolved method) and will block students from building or running the project and from following the intended examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent in the template to match the solution and the Stock usage. Rename the method in the template from 'appendElement(T[] array, T element)' to 'addElementToArray(T[] array, T element)' (preferred), or update all call sites in the template to use 'appendElement'. Prefer aligning the template to the solution (addElementToArray) so students can compile the project and follow the provided examples.
